name: Frax sfrxETH Staking
description: Deposit frxETH into sfrxETH (ERC-4626) to capture the full Frax ETH staking yield concentrated to sfrxETH holders.
use_case: Agent converts ETH→frxETH then deposits into sfrxETH (4626) → receives the concentrated staking yield (frxETH stakers get all validator rewards).

verification.criteria: Tx target is sfrxETH, function deposit(assets,receiver), receiver == agent. Post-tx sfrxETH.balanceOf(agent) increased.
